title: Alternatives tried without consuming input are bounded: a run of empty choices is false or a ResourceLimit error
description: Each of the forty groups of (|)(|)...(|)x matches the empty string in two ways, and the x at the end matches nothing in the empty subject, so a backtracking matcher that tries every combination of the groups' alternatives tries 2^40 of them without examining a character. A processor that counts the alternatives it tries meets its match-cost limit; one that never tries an alternative twice at the same place answers false. Each is a ResourceLimit error or the value false; what no processor may do is run unbounded, or answer true.
